plan_source.semantics: Original plan.py recreates ViTPredictor with current encoder/config-derived dimensions, copies original predictor state_dict strict=True, then passes recreated predictor to VWorldModel. Does not directly retain loaded old predictor as deployed predictor.

predictor_constructor_expected.dim_head_source: ViTPredictor default, not explicit hydra field
predictor_constructor_expected.dim_source: encoder.num_features runtime must equal384; plus two10-dimensional embeddings
predictor_constructor_expected.pool_note: Stored but not used to pool outputs in examined ViTPredictor.forward; output remains tokenwise.

predictor_runtime_assertions.nonpersistent_bias_note: Current source registers causal bias persistent=False; state_dict strict loading alone does not prove old loaded object and reconstructed attention semantics agree. CPU forward comparison is meaningful.

world_model_constructor_expected.other_components: original loaded action_encoder/proprio_encoder/decoder; explicit offline DINO wrapper

encoder_contract.name: dinov2_vits14
encoder_contract.note: Bare DINO backbone without wrapper attributes/forward selection does not meet original VWorldModel contract.

proprio_action_contract.inference_limit: Storage sizes plus source/config are consistent, but do not independently prove tensor shapes; assert loaded Conv1d weight/in_channels/out_channels/kernel_size.

forward_distinction: The training VWorldModel.forward loss path is not identical to rollout. With num_hist3/num_pred1 it expects a training-style4-frame obs/action sequence; passing only3history frames yields mismatched prediction/target lengths. Use the explicitly requested encode/predict/rollout APIs for the3history smoke.
scope_limits: No network, package import, torch import, model/pickle/tensor load, GPU, or new effect experiment.
History3 example is a bounded model-connection test; original planner can start with1observation and grow context. This is not CEM/PushT planner equivalence.
rollout does not invoke decoder. Loading decoder proves neither its forward success nor image reconstruction quality.
Input image/proprio/action are synthetic model-domain tensors; no dataset normalization or environment action success claim.
VWorldModel.eval/train override return None; call separately, not assignment/chaining.
Stored config and ROOT_SPEC static requirements agree; actual DINO dimension and loaded component shapes remain runtime assertions.
Legacy checkpoint old predictor and reconstructed predictor equality is unmeasured, and tolerance must be set before execution.
